known_differences.description: fsci-runtime provides FrankenSciPy-native CASP expected-loss decision engine, EProcessMonitor, PolicyController, and AuditLedger.

threats.description: NaN, negative, or > 1.0 reciprocal condition number rcond passed into SolverPortfolio::select_action.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-runtime/src/lib.rs:456 (select_action): sanitizes non-finite or out-of-range rcond into NearSingular posterior and routes to SVDFallback when drift or e-process alarms fire.
threats.strict_mode_response: Clamp rcond to [0, 1] or assign NearSingular state weights deterministically.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Assign NearSingular posterior and trigger conservative fallback action.

threats.description: Non-finite condition_number_log10 or metadata_incompatibility_score signals passed into PolicyController::decide.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-runtime/src/policy.rs:161 (decide): sanitizes non-finite signals to maximal risk (1.0 logit probability) so non-finite telemetry never biases toward fast unsafe solvers.
threats.strict_mode_response: Sanitize non-finite signal to 1.0 risk and evaluate expected loss.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Sanitize non-finite signal to 1.0 risk with Hardened loss matrix (FailClosed bias).

threats.description: Unbounded memory growth in PolicyEvidenceLedger or conformal calibrator under long-running solver streams.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-runtime/src/evidence.rs:97 (record): enforces FIFO capacity ring buffer on decision and backward-error ledgers.
threats.strict_mode_response: Evict oldest entry when capacity is reached.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Evict oldest entry while preserving EProcessMonitor wealth state.

threats.description: Sustained regime shift in solver backward-error failure rate going undetected by static thresholds.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-runtime/src/eprocess.rs:178 (observe): updates Waudby-Smith & Ramdas betting martingale e-process and latches alarm when e_t >= 1/alpha.
threats.strict_mode_response: Latch e-process alarm and routeSolverPortfolio to SVDFallback.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Latch e-process alarm and emit FallbackTriggered audit event.

fail_closed_policies.strict_mode_action: Clamp to worst-case risk (1.0) in PolicyController::decide.
fail_closed_policies.hardened_mode_action: Clamp to worst-case risk (1.0) and select FailClosed or SVDFallback.

fail_closed_policies.strict_mode_action: Override action selection to SVDFallback until reset_drift.
fail_closed_policies.hardened_mode_action: Override action selection to SVDFallback and record audit event.

fail_closed_policies.strict_mode_action: Refuse fabricated, stale, or conflicting Agent Mail booking ids.
fail_closed_policies.hardened_mode_action: Refuse fabricated, stale, or conflicting Agent Mail booking ids.
